fields.name: Median weekly earnings from paid employment, all groups
fields.population_group: People in paid employment (wages and salaries and/or self-employment) within the HLFS income survey population: non-institutionalised people aged 15 years and over who usually live in New Zealand. Total selected ethnic groups, regions, sexes and ages.
fields.period_convention: June-quarter weekly-income snapshot collected during April–June; self-employment questions cover the preceding 12 months. Not annual earnings.
fields.limitations: Paid-employment earnings are not interchangeable with the wages-and-salaries-only headline or household income. Do not multiply the weekly snapshot by 52 to imply annual earnings.
